You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes in dressing-gown with pipe, seated in an armchair by the fire, gesturing expansively with one hand","action":"Holmes leans back and speaks animatedly while Dr. Watson sits opposite, holding up the morning paper from the floor in a skeptical, half-smiling pose","setting":"Sitting room at 221B Baker Street with a coal fire glowing in the grate and shelves of books and papers around the room","secondaryElements":"Morning paper lying on the floor, grey overcast London visible through the window, a dressing-gown and tweed clothing, a table with scattered papers","mood":"Witty, intimate, dry and contemplative with gentle comic undertone","timeOfDay":"Morning","composition":"Interior two-figure medium shot framed by the fireplace and window, warm coal glow contrasting with soft muted daylight"}
